lines.text: Can you hear a cup fill? Eyes closed, just listening.
lines.phonemes: kæn juː hˈɪɹ ɐ kˈʌp fˈɪl? ˈaɪz klˈoʊzd, dʒˈʌst lˈɪsənɪŋ.

lines.text: Pour water into a cup, and the sound climbs higher and higher. A computer can even work out the water level from the sound alone.
lines.phonemes: pˈɔːɹ wˈɔːɾɚɹ ˌɪntʊ ɐ kˈʌp, ænd ðə sˈaʊnd klˈaɪmz hˈaɪɚ ænd hˈaɪɚ. ɐ kəmpjˈuːɾɚ kæn ˈiːvən wˈɜːk ˈaʊt ðə wˈɔːɾɚ lˈɛvəl fɹʌmðə sˈaʊnd ɐlˈoʊn.

lines.text: The empty space above the water acts like a pipe, closed at the water end. Sound bounces up and down inside it.
lines.phonemes: ðɪ ˈɛmpti spˈeɪs əbˌʌv ðə wˈɔːɾɚɹ ˈækts lˈaɪk ɐ pˈaɪp, klˈoʊzd æt ðə wˈɔːɾɚɹ ˈɛnd. sˈaʊnd bˈaʊnsᵻz ˌʌp ænd dˌaʊn ɪnsˈaɪd ɪt.

lines.text: A short pipe rings higher than a long one. A flute player changes the note by changing the length of the pipe. As the water rises, the empty space shrinks, and the pitch climbs.
lines.phonemes: ɐ ʃˈɔːɹt pˈaɪp ɹˈɪŋz hˈaɪɚ ðˌænə lˈɔŋ wˌʌn. ɐ flˈuːt plˈeɪɚ tʃˈeɪndʒᵻz ðə nˈoʊt baɪ tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ðə lˈɛŋθ ʌvðə pˈaɪp. æz ðə wˈɔːɾɚ ɹˈaɪzᵻz, ðɪ ˈɛmpti spˈeɪs ʃɹˈɪŋks, ænd ðə pˈɪtʃ klˈaɪmz.

lines.text: Less empty space, a higher pitch. With two centimeters left, the cup rings nearly three times higher than when empty.
lines.phonemes: lˈɛs ˈɛmpti spˈeɪs, ɐ hˈaɪɚ pˈɪtʃ. wɪð tˈuː sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz lˈɛft, ðə kˈʌp ɹˈɪŋz nˌɪɹli θɹˈiː tˈaɪmz hˈaɪɚ ðɐn wɛn ˈɛmpti.

lines.text: Measure it: with ten centimeters of empty space, you hear about seven hundred vibrations a second. With two centimeters, you hear nearly two thousand.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛʒɚɹ ɪt: wɪð tˈɛn sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz ʌv ˈɛmpti spˈeɪs, juː hˈɪɹ ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd vˌaɪbɹˈeɪʃənz ɐ sˈɛkənd. wɪð tˈuː sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz, juː hˈɪɹ nˌɪɹli tˈuː θˈaʊzənd.

lines.text: A shorter pipe makes a higher note. Next time you pour, listen: the cup tells you its level.
lines.phonemes: ɐ ʃˈɔːɹɾɚ pˈaɪp mˌeɪks ɐ hˈaɪɚ nˈoʊt. nˈɛkst tˈaɪm juː pˈɔːɹ, lˈɪsən: ðə kˈʌp tˈɛlz juː ɪts lˈɛvəl.

lines.text: Next: a raindrop falls a mile. Why doesn't it hurt?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ ɹˈeɪndɹɑːp fˈɔːlz ɐ mˈaɪl. wˌaɪ dˈʌzənt ɪt hˈɜːt?
